factual_claims.claim: SituationalLLM uses scene graphs to encode real-world environments in a text-based Scene Graph Language.
The SAD-Instruct dataset is derived from 3DSSG, which provides 3D semantic scene graphs for 1,482 RGB-D scans in the 3RScan dataset.
SituationalLLM is fine-tuned using LoRA on LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct.
The SAD-Instruct dataset contains 95.2 million tokens in total.
SituationalLLM fine-tuning takes approximately 48 hours on one H100 80GB GPU.

SituationalLLM is proposed as a framework to improve instruction precision and contextual relevance compared to baseline models, though direct empirical superiority over GPT-4 and LLaMA-3 across all tasks remains subject to specific benchmark validation.
The 3RScan dataset contains up to 534 distinct object classes and 41 relationship types.
The SAD-Instruct dataset is split into 80% training and 20% testing.
